items.headline: Why Baker Mayfield's contract means the QB market could burst
items.description: Baker Mayfield just got $55 million per year in new money -- which is telling about where the QB market is headed. That's great news for 11 other passers ready for big deals.

items.headline: Bears' Odunze feels 'ready' for Panthers despite questionable tag
items.description: Chicago Bears wide receiver Rome Odunze (calf) says he expects to play Sunday in the season opener at Carolina despite being listed as questionable on the final injury report.

items.headline: Sources: Bears, RB Swift agree to 3-year, $33.75M extension
items.description: The Bears and running back D'Andre Swift have reached an agreement on a three-year, $33.75 million extension that includes $27.5 million guaranteed, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.
